title: Stakeholder orchestration: deck stencils + rehearsal scripts (standard & enterprise)
body:
Purpose and audience:
- Quick working kit for ACs and CSMs to run a structured, outcome-focused 60–90 minute partner review.
- Two variants included: Standard (1:1 / SMB style) and Enterprise (multi-stakeholder, exec + technical).
- Emphasis: surface adoption signals, make a concise renewal ask, align on mitigations for risk, and leave with next-step commitments.

How to use this file (notes to self):
- Copy the slide stencils into a new deck per customer. Replace placeholders in ALL-CAPS (e.g., CUSTOMER_NAME).
- Print facilitator script strip for the presenter (one paragraph per slide).
- Use the renewal tracker snippet at the end to keep action owners accountable.
- This doc intentionally contains rough rehearsal cues and optional talk tracks — adapt to account maturity.

Meeting formats and timing guidance:
- Standard (recommended 45–60 minutes): CSM + 1–2 customer stakeholders. Use when adoption metrics are healthy or medium risk.
  - 5m: Welcome + outcomes
  - 10m: Business context & success metrics (customer speaks)
  - 15m: Usage & value highlights (CSM presents)
  - 10m: Risks & blockers + mitigation plan
  - 10m: Renewal signal + next steps

- Enterprise (recommended 60–90 minutes): cross-functional attendees (exec sponsor, product owner, infra/security, CSM). Use when contract value is large or risk profile mixed.
  - 10m: Exec framing (sponsor)
  - 15m: Strategic outcomes & roadmap alignment (customer + CSM)
  - 20m: Operational health & incidents (SRE/CSM)
  - 10m: Cost/efficiency conversation (usage & optimization)
  - 15m: Renewal/contract options + negotiation levers
  - 10m: Commitment & next steps

Slide stencils (order + short intent) — Standard variant:
1) Title + desired outcome (intent: set stage)
   - Title: CUSTOMER_REVIEW | PERIOD (e.g., Q4 FY25)
   - Visual cue: customer logo; presenter names; 2–3 bullets: meeting outcomes

2) One-line business narrative (intent: remind why they bought)
   - Placeholder: WHAT THEY WANT TO ACHIEVE
   - Data point: top KPI (revenue saved, workflows automated, time-to-insight)

3) Adoption snapshot (intent: acceptance & health)
   - Charts: 30/60/90 day active users, API calls/week, successful requests %
   - Quick read: green/amber/red flags in 1 line

4) Value stories (intent: qualitative proof)
   - 2 short customer quotes or case bullets; link to repo of success emails

5) Incident & reliability brief (intent: transparency)
   - Timeline of recent issues, impact, remediation status, SLA hit-rate

6) Efficiency & cost summary (intent: show unit economics)
   - Tokens/day, cost per 1k tokens, batching/quantization recommendations applied

7) Risk matrix + mitigation plan (intent: surface problems & owner)
   - Top 3 risks, confidence, owner, mitigation steps with ETA

8) Renewal ask & options (intent: close for next-step)
   - Proposed renewal tier, term, discount (if any), upsell/expansion asks

9) Decision & commitments (intent: clear next steps)
   - Action list with owner and due date

10) Appendix (intent: backup metrics, logs, tech notes)
   - Links to observability dashboards, ticket numbers, eval reports

Slide stencils — Enterprise variant (differences to highlight):
- Expand the adoption snapshot into cross-team views (product, SRE, analytics).
- Add a section for Compliance & Data (privacy, KMS, on-prem requests).
- Keep a commercial options slide showing reserved capacity vs hosted API economics.
- Include a 1-slide rollout plan for any recommended migrations or private deployments.

Facilitator script (pull-out) — short paragraphs you can read per slide:
- Title: "Hi everyone — thanks for joining. Today we want to confirm value, align on risks, and decide on the renewal path so we can plan capacity and roadmap alignment."
- Business narrative: "Last quarter you highlighted X as the north star. We’ll map observability to that and show where the product is moving the needle."
- Adoption snapshot: "Quickly: active usage rose X% month-over-month, but error rates spiked in the last 2 weeks — we’ll walk through root cause."
- Value stories: "Two quick wins: [TEAM] cut TAT by Y using Redwood inference caching; [ANALYTICS] surfaced a 10% improvement in precision after prompt tweaks."
- Incidents: "On DATE we saw a throughput regression in REGION. Root cause was kernel selection on dedicated nodes; fix deployed; monitoring in place."
- Efficiency: "We recommend a batching profile tweak and quantized variant to reduce unit cost by ~18% on non-sensitive workloads."
- Risks & mitigation: "Top risk is delayed SSO rollout — owner: Product Ops; plan: 2-week sprint; contingency: temporary token-based auth."
- Renewal ask: "We propose moving to a 12-month reserved plan with nominal discount to secure current pricing and priority capacity."

Rehearsal cues (notes to presenter):
- Run through the deck with engineering one day before the meeting to validate incident descriptions.
- Time-box each slide: use speaker timer; keep exec slides to 2–3 minutes max.
- Prepare two asks: a headline ask (primary) and a fallback ask (easier commitment).

Risk scoring mini-framework (one-liner):
- Score each account 1–10 across Adoption, Reliability, Strategic Fit, and Commercial Signal. Total >=30 => low risk, 20–29 => medium, <20 => high risk.
- Example: Adoption 8, Reliability 6, Strategic Fit 7, Commercial 5 => total 26 => medium risk.

Renewal tracker snippet (copy-paste CSV-friendly table for the deck notes):
"Owner,Action,Due,Status,Notes"
"CSM,Confirm renewal tier,CUSTOMER_RENEWAL_DEADLINE,In progress,Waiting on legal review"
"Sales,Contract draft,7 days after meeting,Pending,Needs discount approval"
"Eng,Complete SSO rollout,2026-03-15,Blocked,Dependency on vendor"

Post-meeting email templates (short):
- Exec follow-up (subject): "Summary & commitments — CUSTOMER_NAME review"
  Body bullets: 1) Thank you + outcome 2) Decisions made 3) Actions with owners & dates 4) Next meeting date

- Technical follow-up (subject): "Action items: infra & SSO tasks from review"
  Body bullets: attach ticket links, owners, recommended workaround if blocked

Appendix (what to attach when sending deck):
- Snapshot exports (CSV) from observability (tokens, latencies, error rates)
- Incident timeline doc with PR references
- Cost sensitivity analysis (small table showing token price x usage scenarios)
- Legal/Compliance summary for enterprise asks (KMS, data residency)

Pre-meeting checklist (quick):
- Confirm attendees + exec sponsor 72h prior
- Rehearse slides with eng (24h prior)
- Validate dashboard links and share read-only views
- Prepare two slide PDFs: exec-slim (3 slides) and full-deck
- Bring alternate ask if primary renewal option is not attainable

Open issues / TODOs (notes to the team):
- Add a short slide that visualizes cost savings from Redwood Optimize recommendations (owner: Growth PM).
- Create a one-click export from console for the Adoption snapshot (owner: Console team).
- Standardize the risk scoring legend across CS playbooks (owner: CS Operations).

Quick copyable checklist for CSMs to run live during the meeting:
- "Ask: are we aligned on the primary business metric?"
- "Ask: can we commit to the proposed renewal option today, or do you need a follow-up?"
- "If no: identify the blocker and assign an owner with a 7-day due date."

Versioning and notes: this is a working kit — please update with real examples (replace placeholders). For enterprise decks, attach any signed NDA excerpts or KMS proofs separately.
